title.narrative: 22F-Mercy - Powering the Uptake of climate change Mitigating Pumps - Uganda (PUMP UP)

description.narrative: DGBP 2022. Powering the uptake of climate change Mitigating Pumps. Uganda.

The long-term vision and intended impact of the Pump Up project is to enable farmers in Northern Uganda, including women, youth, and refugee farming communities to build resilient livelihoods and adapt to the negative impacts of climate change. The modality for achieving this goal is to work with and through a well-established private sector partner to extend the reach of climate technologies like solar water pumping for these largely underserved communities, and to couple this access with climate smart agriculture and integrated water resource management practices. In the near term, our vision is to offer an open-source blueprint to the sector. We will capture our learnings in supporting the commercial partner to test, pilot, and iterate on promising go-to-market strategies to reach rural smallholder farmers, including women, youth, and refugees, and to deploy proven approaches at scale. This knowledge repository can be a conduit for raising visibility of the immense potential that exists in rural markets to ultimately crowd-in private sector participation and investment.
The Danida Green Business Partnerships (DGBP) programme funds and supports market-based partnership projects between commercial and non-commercial partners addressing climate and environmental challenges while contributing to inclusive growth and improved livelihoods. The programme builds on previous years’ experience with the private partnership program, DMDP.
